description: This file defines functions and types for managing reactions (emoji responses) in Feishu messages, including adding, removing, and listing reactions, as well as handling API responses and common emoji types.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredFeishuClient
methods.description: Resolves and creates a Feishu client based on the provided configuration and optional account ID.

methods.name: assertFeishuReactionApiSuccess
methods.description: Checks API response for success; throws error if response code is not 0.

methods.name: addReactionFeishu
methods.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a specified message in Feishu.

methods.name: removeReactionFeishu
methods.description: Removes a specified reaction from a message.

methods.name: listReactionsFeishu
methods.description: Lists all reactions for a message, optionally filtered by emoji type.
